headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑fliers but overall modest top‑line expansion.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single‑digits to over 50% YoY. Coforge led with 53.6% growth, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 11% YoY growth. Profit margins improved for most firms, driven by AI‑related deals, but Wipro saw a 1.9% profit decline. Guidance remained steady for most peers, with HCLTech and Wipro introducing new FY27 outlooks.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure on mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Despite strong top‑line growth, companies like LTM and Tech Mahindra posted operating margins below 16%, indicating cost pressures.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 39.9% YoY, the fastest among listed peers.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 11% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Net profit fell 1.9% YoY despite 9.1% revenue growth.
